answer: Give every agent a heartbeat signal that is cheap to send and expensive to fake at scale. Once per epoch, each agent must answer a tiny, unpredictable puzzle within a short window, a zephyr of computation, not a storm, proving a live operator behind the key. Agents that miss three heartbeats slide back to a knoll of restricted rights, where they can only take small jobs until they rebuild a streak. A sybil farmer running ten thousand identities must answer ten thousand puzzles in the same window, which needs real machines and real money, while one honest agent barely notices the breeze.
